tasks.prompt: Create a minimal native mwtl window with a status label and a Close button.
Create a profile form that rejects display names shorter than two characters and focuses the invalid field.
Create a responsive settings window with a fixed navigation column and a stretching content panel.
Create one Save command shared by a button and Ctrl+S, with command dispatch in the window.
Run work on a background thread and safely update a status label on the UI thread when it completes.
Add an Open button that shows a native text-file dialog and displays the selected path or cancellation.
Restore window placement at startup and save it when the window closes.
Create a DPI-aware window that lays out controls in DIPs and refreshes its UI font after a DPI change.
Apply system appearance and give an otherwise ambiguous input an accessible name.
Post and handle an application-defined WM_APP message while preserving mwtl typed dispatch.
Extend an mwtl Notepad-style window with one Always on Top command whose checked state updates the menu and whose value is persisted as a versioned HKCU REG_DWORD setting.
Add a Pause/Resume notification-area command to an mwtl background utility, including Explorer restart recovery and deterministic shutdown.
